variant: mobilenetv2-full-image-set-Adam (TF-Hub feature vector + dense head), converted to TFLite float16 (FLOAT32 I/O)
_comment_normalization: Reproduces the upstream app.py preprocessing: img/255.0 -> [0,1]. NormalizeOp computes (x-mean)/std, so mean=0,std=255 yields x/255. This is the TF-Hub MobileNetV2 feature-vector input convention. (FLOAT32 path; float16 quantization keeps the input/output tensors FLOAT32.)
_comment_preprocessing: PLANTPOTTING-0011 Phase 2 (evidence: docs/sprints/evidence/PLANTPOTTING-0011/preprocessing-decision.md). center_crop measured IDENTICAL to squash on the eval set (no benefit) -> DROPPED, mode stays 'squash'. Multi-crop TTA ADOPTED at 6 views (centre + 4 corners + full-frame): halves the confident-wrong rate (0.254 -> 0.121) at ~5x latency on a one-shot identify. Default tta=1 (off) for any other model; only this production model is locked to 6.
_comment_thresholds: Identical to AIY (PLANTPOTTING-0003 §4.3) EXCEPT high_confidence_abstain_margin=0.30, added in PLANTPOTTING-0011 Phase 3: a high-confidence verdict whose top1-top2 margin is < 0.30 is downgraded to the picker. Tuned on the locked tta6 pipeline (evidence: docs/sprints/evidence/PLANTPOTTING-0011/abstention-before-after.md). With TTA-6 it cuts confident-wrong 0.254->0.083 overall and 0.100->0.000 on clean photos, for an accepted pick-manually rise to ~0.275. Held-out (tune-on-clean/eval-on-perturbation) cw=0.091; leave-one-species-out stable. Do NOT lower the plain/margin gates to flatter a candidate (0006 discipline).
_comment_per_species_thresholds: Empty by design until the Phase 3 swap-eval probe shows an in-vocab species fails the global threshold by a margin a per-class override would cleanly close. Never seed to bless a weak prediction.
_comment_coverage: RECOMPUTE in Phase 4 from the model's actual 47 labels: 10 of 47 mapping entries resolve to KB species; 10 of 16 KB species covered (8 exact + 2 coarse: Orchid->phalaenopsis, Calathea->goeppertia-orbifolia). Headline coverage delta vs AIY: 2/16 -> 10/16. 6 KB species remain out-of-vocab (monstera-adansonii, philodendron-hederaceum, philodendron-pink-princess, ficus-lyrata, chlorophytum-comosum, hoya-carnosa) and route to LowConfidencePicker as before.
_comment_conversion: Converted 2026-06-05 from upstream model/20240921-2014-full-image-set-mobilenetv2-Adam.h5 (sha256 866f6251beb25cef1d02bf6143701a0a6ac39e3458f80ec098f08070d2f16f8f) via convert_house_plant_model.py --quant float16 (TF 2.21.0, tf-keras 2.21.0, tensorflow-hub 0.16.1, TF_USE_LEGACY_KERAS=1).
